title: Search Log
description: One row per search a user runs, used to find searches that return nothing or that nobody opens a result from. Rows older than the tymly_searchLogRetentionDays registry key (default 365) are deleted on boot and once a day.

userId.description: The ID of the user who searched

query.description: The search text, trimmed, lower-cased and with whitespace collapsed

categoryRestriction.description: The categories the search was restricted to

resultOffset.description: The offset of the page of results shown (0 for the first page)

hitCount.description: The total number of results found

durationMs.description: How long the search took, in milliseconds
